a11y.gaps.heading: Known gaps
a11y.gaps.kds: No dedicated screen-reader testing pass on the kitchen display and other real-time views yet — live-updating tickets need an aria-live region audit.
a11y.gaps.rtl: The Arabic right-to-left interface is new. Some screens may still have mirroring or reading-order issues; please report any you find.
a11y.gaps.thirdParty: Browser print dialogs and operating-system file pickers inherit their accessibility from the browser and OS, outside our control.
a11y.gaps.vpat: No published VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) yet.
a11y.practice.alt: Alt text on informative images; decorative graphics are marked aria-hidden so screen readers skip them.
a11y.practice.contrast: Color contrast checked against the design system's light and dark color tokens for the text-on-background combinations used in the main UI.
a11y.practice.focus: Visible focus indicators (focus-visible rings) on all interactive elements — never removed with outline: none.
a11y.practice.forms: Forms (sign in, sign up, checkout) give every input a visible label and show validation errors as text, not color alone.
a11y.practice.heading: What we actually do
a11y.practice.keyboard: Keyboard access for every interactive control, including the mobile menu, tab panels, and form flows — nothing on this site is mouse-only.
a11y.practice.motion: All animation on this site respects prefers-reduced-motion — turn it on in your operating system and page transitions, scroll reveals, and counters appear instantly instead of animating.
a11y.practice.rtl: In Arabic the page language and direction are set on the document (lang="ar", dir="rtl"), so screen readers pronounce text correctly and layouts mirror.
a11y.practice.semantic: Semantic HTML and landmark regions (header, main, nav) throughout, with real buttons and links rather than clickable divs.
a11y.report.body: If you meet an accessibility barrier anywhere in the product, tell your restaurant's administrator or open an issue in the project's <link>source repository</link> with as much detail as you can: the page, the assistive technology you used, and what you expected versus what happened. Accessibility fixes are treated as bugs, not feature requests.
a11y.report.heading: Reporting a problem
a11y.target.body: Ahemad's Restro targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA across this website and the application (POS, dashboard, kitchen display, settings), in both English and Arabic.
a11y.target.heading: Our target
a11y.target.notCertified: This statement is a good-faith snapshot, not a certification. We have not engaged a third-party auditor or obtained formal WCAG conformance certification.
a11y.testing.body: We run automated accessibility audits (axe-core based tools) against live pages during development, and manually review keyboard-only and screen-reader navigation for new or substantially changed screens before release.
a11y.testing.gap: We have not yet run a full manual audit with people who rely on assistive technology every day. That is the biggest gap between a clean automated audit and genuine accessibility, and we won't claim otherwise.
a11y.testing.heading: How we test
a11y.title: Accessibility statement
api.integration.body: Base URL: https://your-domain/api/v1/integrations. Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer ordr_ext_…. This API is for server-to-server calls — your website's own backend calling Ahemad's Restro. Never put the key in browser JavaScript.
api.integration.heading: Integration API
api.mcp.body: Point your MCP client at https://your-domain/api/v1/mcp with the header Authorization: Bearer ordr_staff_… (a personal access token). The server exposes a curated set of tools, and every tool re-checks the same permission the equivalent screen in the app requires:
api.mcp.heading: MCP server
api.mcp.limits: User, role, and API-key management are not available through MCP. Because some tools can change or delete data (for example menu items or tables), give MCP access only to staff whose role already allows those changes.
api.mcp.tools.finance: Reports and finance — profit_and_loss, list_expenses, run_report, and related read-only reports.
api.mcp.tools.menu: Menu — create, update, and delete categories and items (Manage Menu permission).
api.mcp.tools.orders: Orders — list_open_orders, get_order, create_order; cancel_order and refund_order each need their own permission.
api.mcp.tools.staff: Staff — clock_in and clock_out for yourself; attendance, shifts, leave requests, and staff performance with the matching permissions.
api.mcp.tools.tables: Floors and tables — create and update floors, create tables in bulk, update or delete tables, change table status (Manage Tables permission).
api.overview.heading: Ways to connect
api.overview.integration: Integration API — a small REST API for your own website's backend: browse the menu, place orders, and book tables for a location you choose, using an integration key that carries only the scopes you grant.
api.overview.intro: Ahemad's Restro offers three ways to work with your data programmatically. API keys are managed from Settings › API Keys once you're signed in.
api.overview.mcp: MCP server — connect an AI client (Claude Desktop, or any Model Context Protocol client) with a personal access token. It acts as you, with your exact staff permissions.
api.overview.rest: REST API — the same API the app itself uses, documented in an interactive Swagger reference and authenticated with your sign-in session cookie.
api.reference.availability: The reference is always available on development and staging deployments. In production it is only enabled when the operator sets ENABLE_SWAGGER=true, so it may not be reachable on every deployment.
api.reference.body: The full endpoint reference — every route, request body, and response schema — is published as an OpenAPI (Swagger) page at /api/docs, with the raw JSON at /api/docs-json.
api.reference.cookie: The REST API authenticates with the httpOnly session cookie (nodedr_session) set when you sign in. Sign in to Ahemad's Restro in the same browser and Swagger's "Try it out" requests are sent with your session — and limited to your permissions.
api.reference.heading: API reference (Swagger)
api.security.audit: Creating and revoking API keys is recorded in the audit log.
api.security.heading: Security model
api.security.integrationKeys: Integration keys carry no staff identity — a leaked key can only do what its scopes and location allow.
api.security.personalKeys: Personal (MCP) keys inherit your exact role permissions. Revoke one immediately if you suspect it has leaked, just as you would change a password.
api.security.revoke: Revoking a key takes effect immediately.
api.security.shownOnce: Each key is shown in full exactly once, when it is created. After that only its last four characters are displayed.
api.title: API & MCP
compliance.disclaimer.body: This page is not legal or tax advice. It describes what Ahemad's Restro does for restaurants in Saudi Arabia so you can have an informed conversation with your own tax adviser or lawyer. It is not a certification and does not replace professional review. Rules change: always confirm current requirements with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) and your advisers.
compliance.disclaimer.heading: Not legal or tax advice
compliance.invoice.body: For a branch using the Saudi VAT regime, every finalized receipt prints as a simplified tax invoice with Arabic and English labels side by side, the seller's VAT number, and a Phase 1 QR code. The QR code is a Base64-encoded TLV record with these five fields:
compliance.invoice.conditions: The QR code is only printed when the branch's VAT number is set in Settings, and never on provisional (pre-payment) bills. Without a VAT number, receipts are not valid tax invoices.
compliance.invoice.heading: Simplified tax invoice and Phase 1 QR code
compliance.otherRegimes.body: Ahemad's Restro also supports other tax regimes per branch (for example India GST). This edition and this page cover Saudi Arabia only; if you run a branch under another regime, confirm its requirements with a local adviser.
compliance.otherRegimes.heading: Other tax regimes
compliance.pdpl.audit: An audit log records who made key administrative changes and when.
compliance.pdpl.body: Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) applies to personal data you collect about customers and staff — such as names, phone numbers, order history, and loyalty points. Complying with it (lawful basis and consent, privacy notices, responding to data-subject requests, retention, and breach notification) is the responsibility of the restaurant operating Ahemad's Restro.
compliance.pdpl.edit: Customer records can be corrected or deleted by staff with the customer-management permission, to help you handle access, correction, and erasure requests.
compliance.pdpl.heading: Personal data (PDPL)
compliance.pdpl.hosting: Ahemad's Restro is hosted on Cloudflare's global network, so data may be stored or processed outside the Kingdom. Review the PDPL's rules on transferring personal data abroad with your adviser.
compliance.pdpl.isolation: Every record is scoped to its restaurant, so one restaurant's staff cannot see another's customers.
compliance.pdpl.notProvided: Ahemad's Restro does not provide a built-in consent-capture flow, an automatic data-retention schedule, or a privacy-notice page for your guests. Put these in place yourself.
compliance.pdpl.rbac: Role-based permissions limit which staff can see customer contact details and order history.
compliance.pdpl.supports: What the software provides to help:
compliance.phase2.action: If your business falls within a ZATCA Phase 2 integration wave, you will need a separate, ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing solution for those invoices. Check your obligations and deadlines with ZATCA.
compliance.phase2.body: ZATCA's e-invoicing Phase 2 (the integration phase) is not included in Ahemad's Restro. Specifically, it does not:
compliance.phase2.heading: Phase 2 (integration) is not included
compliance.phase2.noFatoora: Report or clear invoices with ZATCA's FATOORA platform.
compliance.phase2.noStamp: Apply a cryptographic stamp or hold a ZATCA-issued certificate (CSID).
compliance.phase2.noXml: Generate invoices in the required XML (UBL 2.1) format.
compliance.questions.body: For questions about how Ahemad's Restro works, contact your account administrator. For your own VAT, e-invoicing, or PDPL obligations, consult a qualified tax adviser or lawyer, and refer to <zatca>ZATCA</zatca> for official guidance. This page cannot answer those questions for your specific situation.
compliance.questions.heading: Questions
compliance.title: Saudi Arabia compliance notes
compliance.vat.body: New restaurants and branches start on the Saudi Arabia — VAT tax regime, with prices in Saudi riyals (SAR).
compliance.vat.currency: Amounts are rounded to the currency's minor unit (halalas) and all totals are calculated on the server.
compliance.vat.heading: VAT rate and VAT-inclusive pricing
compliance.vat.inclusive: Prices are entered and displayed VAT-inclusive, as consumer prices in Saudi Arabia must be. Receipts show the VAT amount included in the total.
compliance.vat.perItem: The rate can be set per item, for example for items that are zero-rated or exempt.
compliance.vat.rate: The default rate is 15%, the standard rate since 1 July 2020. Verify the current rate and any exemptions with ZATCA before going live.
